# OMF Geometry

> The world's largest curated directory of geometric tattoo artists — 130 artists from 28 countries. Sacred geometry, dotwork, mandala, blackwork. Publisher of OMF Geometry Magazine, a limited-run print journal.

## What OMF Geometry Is

OMF Geometry is a curated directory of the world's best geometric tattoo artists. Every artist is hand-selected — no ads, no algorithms, just the work. The directory features artists specializing in sacred geometry, dotwork, mandala, and blackwork styles from 28 countries. Run by @omfgeometry (297K+ Instagram followers).

## OMF Geometry Magazine — Issue 001 (available now)

- Print magazine: 64 pages, six long-form artist interviews (Clément Berdah, Felippe Suezo, Daniele Caputo/Sner, Israel Paketh, Mitch Koch, Ilya Cascad)
- Price: $22 USD (+$5 shipping US, +$15 international)
- Limited edition of 100 numbered copies — no reprint
- Details: https://omfgeometry.com/magazine.html
- Buy: https://all-sacred.myshopify.com/cart/52859987394741:1

## Key Facts

- Artists listed: 130 (and growing)
- Countries represented: 28
- Styles: Sacred geometry, dotwork, mandala, blackwork, geometric realism
- Curator: @omfgeometry on Instagram
- All artists are hand-reviewed before being listed
- Print magazine: Issue 001, $22, limited to 100 copies
